{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2013}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2011–12 |team = Gonzaga Bulldogs |image = Gonzaga Bulldogs wordmark.svg |image_size = 175 |conference = West Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = WCC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 26–7 |conf_record =13–3 |head_coach = [[Mark Few]] |hc_year = 13th |asst_coach1 = [[Tommy Lloyd]] |ac1_year = 11th |asst_coach2 = [[Ray Giacoletti]] |ac2_year = 5th |asst_coach3 = [[Donny Daniels]] |ac3_year = 2nd |stadium = [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] |champion = |bowl =[[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Round of 32 }} {{2011–12 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2011–12 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Gonzaga University]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bulldogs (also informally referred to as the "Zags"), members of the [[West Coast Conference]], were led by head coach [[Mark Few]], in his 13th season at the school. The Zags played most of their home games at the [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] on the university campus in [[Spokane, Washington]], but played one home game at [[Spokane Veterans Memorial Arena|Spokane Arena]], located in [[downtown Spokane]] about 2 miles (3 km) from the Gonzaga campus. The team also played one game at [[KeyArena]] in [[Seattle]], a contest billed as the "Battle in Seattle". This season, the Zags also played a game against [[Hawaii Rainbow Warriors basketball|Hawai{{okina}}i]] at [[Rogers Arena]] in [[Vancouver]], [[British Columbia|BC]]. It was something of a homecoming for center Robert Sacre who is from [[North Vancouver (city)|North Vancouver]]. The Zags had three Canadians on this year's roster, one of whom ([[Kelly Olynyk]]) was [[Redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] and did not play in 2011–12. They finished the season 26–7, 13–3 in WCC play to finish in second place. They lost in the championship game of the [[2012 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|West Coast Basketball tournament]] to Saint Mary's. They received an at-large bid to the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2012 NCAA tournament]], their 14th straight tournament bid, where they defeated West Virginia in the second round before falling in the third round to Ohio State. ==Preseason== In 2011–12, the Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team were in their 32nd season as a member of the [[West Coast Conference]].{{cite web|url=http://www.wccsports.com/school-bio/west-school-bio.html |title=West Coast Conference History |publisher=[[CBS Interactive]] |access-date=November 13, 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130405010428/http://www.wccsports.com/school-bio/west-school-bio.html |archive-date=April 5, 2013 }} Since 2004, the team has played their home games at the [[McCarthey Athletic Center]], which has a capacity of 6,000.{{cite web|url=http://www.gonzaga.edu/Academics/Libraries/Foley-Library/Departments/Special-Collections/exhibitions/GonzagaHistory1990.asp|title=Gonzaga History 1990–present|publisher=[[Gonzaga University]]|access-date=November 13, 2011}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
